cweDef.name: Buffer Copy without Checking Size of Input
cweDef.summary: Unbounded copy and allocation calls overflow their destination when input exceeds its size.

title: Unbounded buffer call {sink} ({lang}) — review required
description: The {lang} call {sink} copies or allocates without a destination bound. Oversized input overflows into adjacent memory. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms bounded use or replaces it with {safe}.
scopeT: Single-line lexical match on the {sink} call in {lang} code.
fp: Fixed small inputs are the common false positive.
recordDesc: In {lang}, {sink} trusts input size. The remedy is {safe}.
fix: Re-run the scan and confirm none remains on untrusted input.
verifyT: Rescan shows no unbounded call on untrusted input.

title: Unbounded scanf conversion ({lang}) — review required
description: A {lang} scan uses an unbounded string conversion: {sink}. Input longer than the buffer overflows it. This lexical rule flags the conversion; the reviewer bounds it via {safe}.
scopeT: Single-line lexical match on scanf conversions in {lang} code.
fp: Fixed-format input is the common false positive.
recordDesc: In {lang}, {sink} scans without a width. The remedy is {safe}.
risk: Stack or heap overflow; HIGH severity.
verifyT: Rescan shows no unbounded conversion.

cweDef.name: Execution with Unnecessary Privileges
cweDef.summary: Privilege-changing calls grant powers the process may not need for its whole lifetime.

title: Privilege or root change via {sink} ({lang}) — review required
description: The {lang} call {sink} changes privilege or filesystem root. Mistakes lock in excessive power or an escapable jail. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms the drop order and confinement via {safe}.
scopeT: Single-line lexical match on the {sink} call in {lang} code.
fp: Correct privilege drops are the common false positive.
recordDesc: In {lang}, {sink} alters privilege or root. The check is {safe}.
risk: Excess privilege or jail escape; MEDIUM severity.
verifyT: Review confirms least privilege.

c:chroot: chdir plus closed descriptors after chroot

title: Umask cleared to zero ({lang}) — review required
description: The process clears its umask: {sink}. New files then keep group and world permissions. This lexical rule flags the clearing; the reviewer restores {safe}.
scopeT: Single-line lexical match on umask clearing in {lang} code.
fp: Brief scoped clearing is the rare accepted case.
recordDesc: In {lang}, {sink} removes the permission mask. The remedy is {safe}.
applicability: {lang} code setting umask; single-line lexical scope.
risk: World-readable or writable files; MEDIUM severity.
verifyT: Rescan shows no cleared umask.

cweDef.name: Time-of-check Time-of-use Race Condition

scopeT: Single-line lexical match on the {sink} call in {lang} code.
fp: Display-only checks are the common false positive.
recordDesc: In {lang}, {sink} pre-checks files. The remedy is {safe}.
verifyT: Rescan shows no pre-check before use.
